name: Extension traces in the DOM and globals
plain: Browser extensions leave marks in the page that the page can see.
meaning: Ad blockers, password managers and similar tools add elements, attributes and global variables to pages. A page that looks for those marks can tell which of them you run. It works in all desktop browsers.

web.api: document.querySelectorAll for injected nodes; compare window globals against a clean iframe; MutationObserver on documentElement

chrome.note: Content scripts run in an isolated world but the DOM they change is shared

ios_safari.note: Safari web extensions on iOS and iPadOS from 15; content scripts share the page DOM

data.metric: Browser extensions leave marks in the page that the page can see.

fields.name: injected nodes
fields.range: ids, classes, custom elements, attributes on html or body

fields.name: new globals
fields.range: names missing from a clean window

fields.name: chrome-extension:// URLs
fields.range: image or script sources inside the document

limits.headline: Can spot some of your extensions from what they add to the page
limits.user_action: None, the page reads it silently
can: See attributes an extension set on html or body
See globals an extension exposed to the page world
cannot: List extensions that do not touch the page
limits.differs: Desktop browsers. Extension code in the isolated world is hidden, but anything it writes to the page DOM or MAIN world is visible.

story.what_it_is: The page looks for the footprints extensions leave behind.

marketing.name: Content scripts
marketing.pitch: Explains how extensions run scripts in pages and what they can change.

story.for_you: A site can notice that you run an ad blocker or a password manager without asking.
story.for_makers: Makers detect ad blockers to show a wall, and detect scraping or automation extensions.

use_cases.example: A news site notices an ad blocker and shows a notice.
A site checks for scraping extensions.

technical_bounds: Only extensions that modify the page are visible
Content script isolated world variables are hidden
Spectroscopy style timing signals are low confidence

linkedin.how: BrowserGate also scans the DOM for injected extension nodes beside its chrome-extension URL probe.
